evidence.reason: After edit calls reminders.evaluate(minutes, undefined, "benchmark") and drops reminders.initialize(), changing both the multiplier and calendar inputs relied on by the prior behavior.
Default multiplier changed from configuration.rate to 0, so any caller passing undefined (as scheduledDelay now does) receives a different computation via priorities[0].
Test still asserts evaluate with explicit multiplier 0.1 and calendar "work", which no longer matches scheduledDelay's new "benchmark" calendar usage.
Test only asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, so it cannot detect the semantic change from "work" to "benchmark" or the undefined multiplier.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动叠加后，scheduledDelay 传入的 undefined 乘数与 "benchmark" 日历会与 reminderDelay 新的默认值 0 共同改变计算结果，而现有测试无法覆盖这一组合，存在行为回归风险。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay：恢复 reminders.initialize()，并将 evaluate 的第二个参数显式传回 0.1、第三个参数改回 "work"（或同步更新 src/reminders.ts#reminderDelay 的默认乘数并补充对应测试）。
